title: Monotonicity conjecture for the point-evaluation constants
statement:
Let $\mathscr{C}_p$ denote the point-evaluation constant associated with the Paley–Wiener space $PW^p$. **Monotonicity conjecture.** The function

$$
p \mapsto \frac{\mathscr{C}_p}{p}
$$

is strictly decreasing on $(0,\infty)$. If true, this hypothesis would likely yield a simpler proof of the relevant point-evaluation theorem and imply further bounds for $\mathscr{C}_p$.
source_name: Ole Fredrik Brevig, Andrés Chirre, Joaquim Ortega-Cerdà and Kristian Seip, “Point evaluation in Paley–Wiener spaces”, arXiv:2210.13922 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2210.13922

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of October 2022).

title: Monotonicity conjecture for the median of a weighted sum of gamma variables
statement:
Let $X_1$ and $X_2$ be independent $Gamma(r,1)$ random variables, and define

$$
Z_\alpha=\alpha X_1+(2-\alpha)X_2,\qquad \alpha>0.
$$

**Gamma-sum median conjecture.** The function $\alpha\mapsto\operatorname{Med}(Z_\alpha)$ is non-decreasing for $\alpha\in(0,1)$. This is one of two conjectures concerning medians of sums and differences of independent gamma random variables; its status is not resolved in the supplied text.
source_name: Robert E. Gaunt and Milan Merkle, “On bounds for the mode and median of the generalized hyperbolic and related distributions”, arXiv:2002.01884 (2020).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.01884

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2020).

title: The monotonicity conjecture for quotients of squared Bessel zeros
statement:
Let $j_{1,k}$ denote the $k$th positive zero of the Bessel function of the first kind of order $1$, with the convention $j_{1,0}=0$, and define

$$
\hat q_k=\frac{j_{1,k+1}^2-j_{1,k}^2}{j_{1,k}^2-j_{1,k-1}^2}.
$$

**The Bessel-zero quotient monotonicity conjecture.** The quotients $\hat q_k$ decrease monotonically as $k\in\mathbb{N}$ increases. The conjecture is supported by numerical experiments, but no resolution is given in the source.
source_name: Kolja Brix, Claudio Canuto and Wolfgang Dahmen, “Legendre-Gauss-Lobatto grids and associated nested dyadic grids”, arXiv:1311.0028 (2013).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1311.0028

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of November 2013).

title: Chen–Cheung's generalized Wilker inequality conjecture
statement:
For $0<x<\pi/2$ and $n\geq3$, let $B_n$ be the Bernoulli numbers defined by

$$
\frac{t}{e^t-1}=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}B_n\frac{t^n}{n!},\qquad |t|<2\pi.
$$

**Chen–Cheung's generalized Wilker inequality conjecture.**

$$
\begin{aligned}
&2+\sum_{k=3}^{n}\frac{\big(2(2^{2k}-1)|B_{2k}|-(-1)^k\big)2^{2k-1}}{(2k)!}x^{2k-2}\\
&\quad+\frac{\big(2(2^{2n+2}-1)|B_{2n+2}|-(-1)^{n+1}\big)2^{2n+1}}{(2n+2)!}x^{2n-1}\tan x\\
&\qquad<\left(\frac{\sin x}{x}\right)^2+\frac{\tan x}{x}\\
&\qquad<2+\sum_{k=3}^{n}\frac{\big(2(2^{2k}-1)|B_{2k}|-(-1)^k\big)2^{2k-1}}{(2k)!}x^{2k-2}+\left(\frac{2}{\pi}\right)^{2n}x^{2n-1}\tan x.
\end{aligned}
$$

This conjecture extends the sharp Wilker-type bounds known for the first few terms of the expansions of $(\sin x/x)^2+\tan x/x$.
source_name: C. P Chen and R B Paris, “On the Wilker and Huygens-type inequalities”, arXiv:1602.00436 (2016).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/1602.00436

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of February 2016).
